# A flat serve fee can still be a losing job.

> Free calculator for independent process servers: find real net profit for one service-of-process job after extra attempts, rush and skip-trace fees, mileage, and your own drive time and vehicle cost, then compare what two or three client law firms actually pay per hour.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
